setup.en: Use a fixed overhead bar that supports your bodyweight. Put a stable step underneath so you can take and release the grip without jumping; use foot assistance for learning.
setup.zh: 用能承受体重的固定单杠，下方放稳固踏台，方便握杠和下杠，不用跳起抓杠；学习时可用脚辅助。

steps.en: Step up and take an overhand grip a little wider than shoulder width, thumbs wrapped around the bar. Start with arms long in a comfortable overhead position.
steps.zh: 站上踏台，正握单杠，握距比肩稍宽，拇指扣住。手臂伸长，从舒服的举臂位置开始。

steps.en: Keep your head aligned with the trunk and gently brace the abdomen. Let the shoulder blades follow the overhead arm position rather than pinning them down.
steps.zh: 头与躯干保持一线，腹部轻轻收紧。肩胛骨顺着举臂位置移动，不要先把它们死压住。

steps.en: Breathe out as you pull your upper arms down towards your sides and bend the elbows. Lift the body without kicking or swinging.
steps.zh: 呼气，上臂向身体两侧下拉，同时屈肘，把身体拉起，不踢腿、不摆荡。

steps.en: Rise only as far as you can keep the neck quiet; bring the chin near the bar without reaching it forward. Back and elbow flexors work together.
steps.zh: 只拉到颈部还能保持自然的高度；下巴靠近单杠，不要往前探。背部和屈肘肌共同用力。

steps.en: Breathe in and lower slowly until the arms are long again, allowing the shoulder blades to rotate with them. Keep assistance if you cannot control the return.
steps.zh: 吸气，慢慢下降到手臂再次伸长，让肩胛骨随之回旋。下放控制不了时，继续用脚辅助。

steps.en: Return your feet to the step before releasing your grip. Move back to an easier pull-down if hanging or lowering is not comfortable.
steps.zh: 先把脚放回踏台，再松手；悬垂或下放不舒服时，改用较容易的高位下拉。

cues.en: Pull the upper arms down; the elbows bend as part of the same movement.
cues.zh: 上臂向下拉；屈肘是同一个动作的一部分。

cues.en: Let the shoulder blades move with the arms.
cues.zh: 让肩胛骨跟着手臂移动。

cues.en: Back and arms may both feel effort; no particular burn is required.
cues.zh: 背和手臂都可能有用力感，不必追求某一处特别酸。

mistakes.en: Kicking and swinging to get over the bar. Why: momentum replaces part of the pull and makes the return harder to control.
mistakes.zh: 踢腿摆荡，借力过杠。为什么：惯性代替了部分拉力，也让下放更难控制。

mistakes.en: Reaching the chin forward at the top. Why: neck movement changes the apparent height without completing the shoulder movement.
mistakes.zh: 顶端把下巴往前伸。为什么：脖子改变了看起来的高度，肩关节却没有完成相应运动。

text.en: Choose a load or assistance level that lets you control the whole movement, and progress gradually when the same technique feels easy.
text.zh: 选择能控制整个动作的重量或辅助程度；同样的动作变得轻松后，再逐步加难。

text.en: Rest until you can repeat the movement smoothly, and end the effort when control begins to fade.
text.zh: 休息到能重新平稳完成动作；控制开始变差时，就结束这一轮。

cautions.en: The 3D view traces the shoulder and elbow paths with a shortened range; use the two-panel drawing for the full body position and apparatus.
cautions.zh: 三维视图以缩小幅度描出肩、肘的运动；完整体位和器械请看两格示意图。

cautions.en: Stop if hanging brings sharp shoulder pain, tingling or a loss of grip; step down with assistance.
cautions.zh: 悬垂时出现肩部刺痛、麻感或握力突然下降，就在辅助下踩回踏台、停止动作。

cautions.en: First learn with bodyweight, assistance or a light load under a qualified coach; anyone under 18 should practise under adult supervision.
cautions.zh: 第一次做先用自重、辅助或轻重量，在合格教练指导下学动作；未满 18 岁在成人监督下练习。

cautions.en: This card is general information, not medical advice. For pain or an injury, see a doctor or physiotherapist.
cautions.zh: 本卡片是一般性知识，不是医疗建议；有疼痛或受伤，请咨询医生或物理治疗师。

text.en: Youdas et al. (2010) measured surface EMG during pull-up variations in 21 men and 4 women; latissimus dorsi and biceps brachii were active in the conventional pull-up. This measures activity, not a ranking of muscle growth.
text.zh: Youdas 等（2010）在 21 名男性和 4 名女性的不同引体动作中记录表面肌电；普通引体向上有背阔肌和肱二头肌参与。这测的是肌肉活动，不能用来给增肌效果排名。

setup.en: Use a cable lat-pulldown station with a long bar. Set the seat and thigh pad so the feet are flat and the thighs stay in place; begin with a light stack.
setup.zh: 用带长拉杆的高位下拉器械。调好座椅和压腿垫，双脚踩平，大腿能稳住；先选较轻的配重。

steps.en: Stand to take an overhand grip a little wider than the shoulders, thumbs around the bar, then sit with thighs securely under the pad.
steps.zh: 站起正握拉杆，握距比肩稍宽，拇指扣住；坐下，把大腿放稳在压腿垫下面。

steps.en: Let the arms reach overhead in a comfortable range. Sit tall with a small, fixed backward lean and keep the ribs over the pelvis.
steps.zh: 手臂在舒服的范围里向上伸长。坐稳，保持小幅度、固定的后倾，肋骨不往前顶。

steps.en: Breathe out and draw the upper arms down towards the ribs while bending the elbows. Bring the bar in front of the face towards the upper chest.
steps.zh: 呼气，上臂向肋骨两侧下拉，同时屈肘；拉杆从面前走向上胸。

steps.en: Stop when the elbows are near the sides and the bar is close to the upper chest; touching the chest is not required. Keep the torso still.
steps.zh: 手肘接近身体两侧、拉杆靠近上胸时就停，不必强求碰到胸。躯干保持不动。

steps.en: Breathe in and let the bar rise slowly as the elbows straighten and the shoulder blades turn upward. Keep the weights from crashing.
steps.zh: 吸气，让拉杆慢慢上升，手肘伸长，肩胛骨向上回旋，不让配重砸落。

steps.en: Let the stack settle gently after the last return. Stand with the bar under control and release it without letting it snap overhead.
steps.zh: 最后回放后让配重轻轻落稳；控制着拉杆站起，再松手，不让它猛地弹向上方。

cues.en: Move the upper arms towards the ribs, rather than curling the bar to the chin.
cues.zh: 上臂向肋骨靠近，不是把拉杆弯举到下巴。

cues.en: Keep the backward lean small and unchanged.
cues.zh: 后倾幅度小，整个动作保持不变。

mistakes.en: Pulling behind the neck. Why: it requires a different shoulder position and often encourages the head to jut forward.
mistakes.zh: 拉到颈后。为什么：这需要不同的肩部位置，也常让头向前探。

mistakes.en: Rocking the torso to pull a heavy stack. Why: the moving trunk supplies momentum and changes the exercise into a row.
mistakes.zh: 晃动躯干拉大重量。为什么：躯干产生惯性，动作也逐渐变成划船。

text.en: Choose a load or assistance level that lets you control the whole movement, and progress gradually when the same technique feels easy.
text.zh: 选择能控制整个动作的重量或辅助程度；同样的动作变得轻松后，再逐步加难。

text.en: Rest until you can repeat the movement smoothly, and end the effort when control begins to fade.
text.zh: 休息到能重新平稳完成动作；控制开始变差时，就结束这一轮。

cautions.en: The 3D view traces the shoulder and elbow paths with a shortened range; use the two-panel drawing for the full body position and apparatus.
cautions.zh: 三维视图以缩小幅度描出肩、肘的运动；完整体位和器械请看两格示意图。

cautions.en: Use a smaller range or lighter load if the overhead position is uncomfortable; stop for sharp pain.
cautions.zh: 举臂位置不舒服时，减小幅度或减轻重量；出现刺痛就停。

cautions.en: First learn with bodyweight, assistance or a light load under a qualified coach; anyone under 18 should practise under adult supervision.
cautions.zh: 第一次做先用自重、辅助或轻重量，在合格教练指导下学动作；未满 18 岁在成人监督下练习。

cautions.en: This card is general information, not medical advice. For pain or an injury, see a doctor or physiotherapist.
cautions.zh: 本卡片是一般性知识，不是医疗建议；有疼痛或受伤，请咨询医生或物理治疗师。

text.en: Lusk, Hale and Russell (2010) studied 12 healthy men doing front pull-downs at 70% of their maximum. A pronated grip produced higher latissimus EMG than a supinated grip; grip width did not explain the difference. EMG does not establish greater muscle growth.
text.zh: Lusk、Hale 和 Russell（2010）研究了 12 名健康男性用最大重量的 70% 做颈前下拉。正握的背阔肌肌电高于反握；握距不能解释这一差异。肌电高并不能证明肌肉长得更多。

setup.en: Use a barbell with collars and a clear floor space. Start light; you must be able to hold a hip hinge without the back shape changing.
setup.zh: 用装好卡扣的杠铃，周围地面留出空间。先用轻重量；你需要能稳住髋折叠姿势，让脊柱形态不变。

steps.en: Stand with feet about hip width and take an overhand grip just outside the legs. Lift the light bar to standing using the hip-hinge technique before setting up the row.
steps.zh: 双脚约与髋同宽，正握杠铃，握距略宽于双腿。先按髋折叠的提杠方法把轻杠提到站姿，再准备划船。

steps.en: Soften the knees and send the hips back until the torso slopes forward. Keep the spine long and the abdomen gently braced, with the bar hanging below the shoulders.
steps.zh: 膝盖微屈，髋向后移，让躯干前倾。脊柱保持自然延长，腹部轻轻收紧，杠垂在肩下。

steps.en: Breathe out and pull the bar towards the lower ribs or upper abdomen, elbows travelling back near the sides. Keep the torso at the same angle.
steps.zh: 呼气，把杠拉向下胸或上腹，手肘在身体两侧向后走，躯干倾角不变。

steps.en: Let the shoulder blades come towards the spine without forcing the shoulders or elbows far behind the body. Stop at a controlled, comfortable top position.
steps.zh: 让肩胛骨向脊柱靠近，不要强行把肩膀或手肘拉到身后很远；在能控制、舒服的位置停下。

steps.en: Breathe in and lower the bar slowly until the arms are long. Allow a small natural forward glide of the shoulder blades without rounding the whole back.
steps.zh: 吸气，慢慢下放到手臂伸长；允许肩胛骨自然向前滑一点，但不要把整个背弓起来。

steps.en: To finish, straighten the hips to stand, then return the bar to the floor with a controlled hip hinge.
steps.zh: 结束时先伸髋站起，再用有控制的髋折叠把杠放回地面。

cues.en: Hold the hinge; move the arms and shoulder blades.
cues.zh: 髋折叠姿势稳住，移动手臂和肩胛骨。

cues.en: Let the bar travel close to the legs.
cues.zh: 杠的路线靠近双腿。

cues.en: The back columns hold steady rather than pumping the spine.
cues.zh: 脊柱两旁的肌柱稳住，不反复屈伸脊柱。

mistakes.en: Standing up with each pull. Why: hip movement gives the bar momentum instead of keeping the row controlled.
mistakes.zh: 每拉一下就把身体挺起来。为什么：髋部运动给杠铃加了惯性，划船不再受控。

mistakes.en: Rounding the lower back as the bar descends. Why: the spinal position changes under load instead of the arms reaching forward.
mistakes.zh: 下放时弓起下背。为什么：变化的是负重下的脊柱位置，不是手臂和肩胛骨正常回放。

text.en: Choose a load or assistance level that lets you control the whole movement, and progress gradually when the same technique feels easy.
text.zh: 选择能控制整个动作的重量或辅助程度；同样的动作变得轻松后，再逐步加难。

text.en: Rest until you can repeat the movement smoothly, and end the effort when control begins to fade.
text.zh: 休息到能重新平稳完成动作；控制开始变差时，就结束这一轮。

cautions.en: The 3D view traces the shoulder and elbow paths with a shortened range; use the two-panel drawing for the full body position and apparatus.
cautions.zh: 三维视图以缩小幅度描出肩、肘的运动；完整体位和器械请看两格示意图。

cautions.en: Use a supported dumbbell row if holding the hinge is uncomfortable or cannot be controlled.
cautions.zh: 维持俯身不舒服或控制不了时，可改用有支撑的哑铃划船。

cautions.en: First learn with bodyweight, assistance or a light load under a qualified coach; anyone under 18 should practise under adult supervision.
cautions.zh: 第一次做先用自重、辅助或轻重量，在合格教练指导下学动作；未满 18 岁在成人监督下练习。

cautions.en: This card is general information, not medical advice. For pain or an injury, see a doctor or physiotherapist.
cautions.zh: 本卡片是一般性知识，不是医疗建议；有疼痛或受伤，请咨询医生或物理治疗师。

setup.en: Use a stable flat bench and a light dumbbell. The drawing shows the left arm rowing, with the right hand and right knee supported; reverse the sides afterwards.
setup.zh: 用稳固平板凳和轻哑铃。图中左臂划船，右手、右膝支撑；随后换边。

steps.en: Place the right knee and right hand on the bench. Plant the left foot wide enough to balance; keep the torso nearly horizontal and the pelvis square.
steps.zh: 右膝、右手撑在凳上，左脚踩地，站到能稳住的位置；躯干接近水平，骨盆不扭转。

steps.en: Take the dumbbell in the left hand with the palm facing in. Let the arm hang under the shoulder and keep the wrist straight.
steps.zh: 左手握哑铃，掌心向内；手臂垂在肩下，手腕平直。

steps.en: Breathe out and draw the left elbow towards the hip, bringing the dumbbell towards the lower ribs. Keep the chest facing the floor.
steps.zh: 呼气，左肘朝髋部方向拉，让哑铃靠近下位肋骨；胸口始终朝地面。

steps.en: Stop when the upper arm is near the torso. Let the shoulder blade move back without twisting the trunk to lift the weight higher.
steps.zh: 上臂接近躯干就停；肩胛骨向后移，不扭转躯干把哑铃拉得更高。

steps.en: Breathe in and lower slowly to a long arm, allowing the shoulder blade to glide forward while keeping the back shape steady.
steps.zh: 吸气，慢慢放回手臂伸长的位置；肩胛骨向前滑，脊柱形态保持不变。

steps.en: Put the dumbbell on the floor under control, step away from the bench, and reset the same support on the other side.
steps.zh: 把哑铃有控制地放回地面，离开凳子，再按同样的支撑方式换边。

cues.en: Keep the belt line facing the floor.
cues.zh: 腰带线保持朝向地面。

cues.en: Move the elbow towards the hip; keep the wrist quiet.
cues.zh: 手肘朝髋部拉，手腕不乱弯。

mistakes.en: Opening the chest to the side as the weight rises. Why: trunk rotation supplies movement that should come from the shoulder and scapula.
mistakes.zh: 拉起时胸口转向一侧。为什么：躯干旋转代替了应由肩关节和肩胛骨完成的运动。

mistakes.en: Pulling the shoulder towards the ear. Why: the movement becomes shoulder elevation rather than the intended backward arm pull.
mistakes.zh: 肩膀拉向耳朵。为什么：动作变成提肩，而不是预期的上臂后拉。

text.en: Choose a load or assistance level that lets you control the whole movement, and progress gradually when the same technique feels easy.
text.zh: 选择能控制整个动作的重量或辅助程度；同样的动作变得轻松后，再逐步加难。

text.en: Rest until you can repeat the movement smoothly, and end the effort when control begins to fade.
text.zh: 休息到能重新平稳完成动作；控制开始变差时，就结束这一轮。

cautions.en: The 3D view traces the shoulder and elbow paths with a shortened range; use the two-panel drawing for the full body position and apparatus.
cautions.zh: 三维视图以缩小幅度描出肩、肘的运动；完整体位和器械请看两格示意图。

cautions.en: Keep the bench stable and the supporting wrist comfortable; change the support or stop if pain persists.
cautions.zh: 凳子必须稳固，支撑腕保持舒服；疼痛持续时调整支撑或停止。

cautions.en: First learn with bodyweight, assistance or a light load under a qualified coach; anyone under 18 should practise under adult supervision.
cautions.zh: 第一次做先用自重、辅助或轻重量，在合格教练指导下学动作；未满 18 岁在成人监督下练习。

cautions.en: This card is general information, not medical advice. For pain or an injury, see a doctor or physiotherapist.
cautions.zh: 本卡片是一般性知识，不是医疗建议；有疼痛或受伤，请咨询医生或物理治疗师。

setup.en: Fix a horizontal bar securely in a rack and check it cannot roll or lift free. Begin with the bar high enough for an easy body angle; clear the floor beneath it.
setup.zh: 把横杆牢固固定在架上，确认不会转动或脱出。开始时把杆放得高一些，让身体倾角容易控制；清空下方地面。

steps.en: Take an overhand grip just wider than the shoulders and walk the feet forward under the bar. Begin with arms long and the heels on a non-slip floor.
steps.zh: 正握横杆，握距比肩稍宽，双脚向前迈到杆下。手臂伸长，脚跟踩在不打滑的地面上。

steps.en: Keep the head, trunk and pelvis in line. Gently tighten the abdomen and buttocks; bend the knees for an easier version if needed.
steps.zh: 头、躯干和骨盆保持一线，腹部和臀部轻轻收紧；需要时屈膝，改成更容易的版本。

steps.en: Breathe out and pull the chest towards the bar, bending the elbows and bringing the shoulder blades back. Move the whole body together.
steps.zh: 呼气，胸口向杆靠近，同时屈肘、肩胛骨后缩；身体作为一个整体移动。

steps.en: Stop when the chest is close to the bar without reaching with the chin or thrusting the hips. Keep the upper arms at a comfortable angle.
steps.zh: 胸口靠近杆就停，不伸下巴、不挺髋借力；上臂保持舒服的角度。

steps.en: Breathe in and lower the whole body slowly to long arms, letting the shoulder blades glide forward without losing the body line.
steps.zh: 吸气，整个人慢慢下放到手臂伸长，让肩胛骨向前滑，身体仍保持一线。

steps.en: Walk the feet back and stand before letting go. Change the bar height or knee position before the next attempt if control was difficult.
steps.zh: 双脚向后走，站稳再松手；控制困难时，下一轮开始前调整横杆高度或屈膝程度。

cues.en: Bring the chest to the bar, not the chin.
cues.zh: 胸口靠近杆，不是下巴凑过去。

cues.en: Keep chest and hips moving together.
cues.zh: 胸口和髋部一起移动。

mistakes.en: Letting the pelvis sag. Why: the trunk bends instead of remaining a steady link between shoulders and feet.
mistakes.zh: 骨盆下塌。为什么：躯干发生弯折，不能作为肩膀与脚之间的稳定连接。

mistakes.en: Thrusting the hips to start the pull. Why: momentum replaces controlled shoulder and elbow movement.
mistakes.zh: 先挺髋再拉。为什么：惯性代替了受控的肩、肘运动。

text.en: Choose a load or assistance level that lets you control the whole movement, and progress gradually when the same technique feels easy.
text.zh: 选择能控制整个动作的重量或辅助程度；同样的动作变得轻松后，再逐步加难。

text.en: Rest until you can repeat the movement smoothly, and end the effort when control begins to fade.
text.zh: 休息到能重新平稳完成动作；控制开始变差时，就结束这一轮。

cautions.en: The 3D view traces the shoulder and elbow paths with a shortened range; use the two-panel drawing for the full body position and apparatus.
cautions.zh: 三维视图以缩小幅度描出肩、肘的运动；完整体位和器械请看两格示意图。

cautions.en: Use a securely fixed bar; a loose broomstick or an unsecured table is not a suitable support.
cautions.zh: 用可靠固定的横杆；松动的棍子或未固定的桌子不适合作支撑。

cautions.en: First learn with bodyweight, assistance or a light load under a qualified coach; anyone under 18 should practise under adult supervision.
cautions.zh: 第一次做先用自重、辅助或轻重量，在合格教练指导下学动作；未满 18 岁在成人监督下练习。

cautions.en: This card is general information, not medical advice. For pain or an injury, see a doctor or physiotherapist.
cautions.zh: 本卡片是一般性知识，不是医疗建议；有疼痛或受伤，请咨询医生或物理治疗师。

name.en: Cable face pull with external rotation

setup.en: Attach a rope to a cable pulley around eye height. Select a light load and leave room to step back; the drawing shows the version that finishes with gentle external rotation.
setup.zh: 把绳索装在约眼高的滑轮上，选轻配重，留出后退空间；图示版本在拉回时配合轻柔外旋。

steps.en: Hold a rope end in each hand with palms facing in. Step back until the arms are long and the stack is just lifted; feet are about hip width, knees soft.
steps.zh: 两手各握绳端，掌心相对。后退到手臂伸长、配重刚离开底座；双脚约与髋同宽，膝盖微屈。

steps.en: Keep the ribs over the pelvis and the head still. Start with the hands at eye height and shoulders relaxed in their natural position.
steps.zh: 肋骨位于骨盆上方，头保持自然。双手从眼高处开始，肩膀放在自然位置。

steps.en: Breathe out and pull the rope towards the forehead while spreading the hands apart. Elbows travel out and back around shoulder height.
steps.zh: 呼气，把绳索拉向额前，两手逐渐分开；手肘在约肩高处向外、向后走。

steps.en: Turn the upper arms outward so the hands finish beside the temples and the forearms are close to upright. Stop before you have to arch the back or force the shoulders.
steps.zh: 上臂向外旋，让双手停在太阳穴旁，前臂接近竖直；需要弓腰或强拧肩膀之前就停。

steps.en: Breathe in and reverse the rotation, then let the arms extend slowly towards the pulley. Let the shoulder blades glide forward and keep the stack quiet.
steps.zh: 吸气，沿原路线回转，再慢慢向滑轮方向伸长手臂；肩胛骨向前滑，配重不砸落。

steps.en: Step forward under control until the stack rests before releasing the rope.
steps.zh: 有控制地向前走，让配重落稳后再松开绳索。

cues.en: Separate the rope ends; turn the upper arms, not the wrists.
cues.zh: 两端绳索分开；转上臂，不是翻手腕。

cues.en: Keep the ribs and head quiet as the elbows move.
cues.zh: 手肘移动时，肋骨和头保持稳定。

cues.en: Use a comfortable shoulder range rather than forcing a pose.
cues.zh: 在肩部舒服的范围里做，不强凑姿势。

mistakes.en: Leaning back to move a heavy stack. Why: trunk movement replaces part of the shoulder work.
mistakes.zh: 靠后仰拉动大配重。为什么：躯干运动代替了部分肩部工作。

mistakes.en: Bending the wrists to fake the final rotation. Why: the handles move but the upper arms hardly rotate.
mistakes.zh: 靠折腕假装完成最后的外旋。为什么：把手移动了，上臂却几乎没有旋转。

text.en: Choose a load or assistance level that lets you control the whole movement, and progress gradually when the same technique feels easy.
text.zh: 选择能控制整个动作的重量或辅助程度；同样的动作变得轻松后，再逐步加难。

text.en: Rest until you can repeat the movement smoothly, and end the effort when control begins to fade.
text.zh: 休息到能重新平稳完成动作；控制开始变差时，就结束这一轮。

cautions.en: The 3D view traces the shoulder and elbow paths with a shortened range; use the two-panel drawing for the full body position and apparatus.
cautions.zh: 三维视图以缩小幅度描出肩、肘的运动；完整体位和器械请看两格示意图。

cautions.en: Do not force the hands behind the head. Reduce the rotation or stop if the shoulder pinches.
cautions.zh: 不要强行把手拉到脑后；肩部有夹痛时，减少外旋幅度或停止。

cautions.en: First learn with bodyweight, assistance or a light load under a qualified coach; anyone under 18 should practise under adult supervision.
cautions.zh: 第一次做先用自重、辅助或轻重量，在合格教练指导下学动作；未满 18 岁在成人监督下练习。

cautions.en: This card is general information, not medical advice. For pain or an injury, see a doctor or physiotherapist.
cautions.zh: 本卡片是一般性知识，不是医疗建议；有疼痛或受伤，请咨询医生或物理治疗师。

setup.en: Choose dumbbells light enough to hold without leaning or bending the wrists. Stand in a clear space with room to put them down safely.
setup.zh: 选择拿着时不用歪身、折腕的轻哑铃；在空旷处站好，留出安全放回哑铃的空间。

steps.en: Stand with feet about hip width, knees soft and arms by the sides. Hold the dumbbells with palms facing in and thumbs wrapped around the handles.
steps.zh: 双脚约与髋同宽，膝盖微屈，手臂在身体两侧；对握哑铃，拇指扣住把手。

steps.en: Keep the head over the trunk, elbows long and wrists straight. Let the shoulder girdle settle naturally without forcing it down.
steps.zh: 头位于躯干上方，手肘伸长、手腕平直；肩带自然放稳，不强行下压。

steps.en: Breathe out and lift the shoulders smoothly towards the ears. The arms stay long; let the shoulder girdle provide the movement.
steps.zh: 呼气，肩膀平稳朝耳朵方向上提；手臂保持伸长，由肩带产生运动。

steps.en: Pause briefly at a comfortable top position without pushing the chin forward or rolling the shoulders.
steps.zh: 在舒服的顶端稍停，不伸下巴、不绕肩。

steps.en: Breathe in and lower the shoulders slowly back to their natural resting height. Put the weights down under control when finished.
steps.zh: 吸气，肩膀慢慢回到自然高度；结束时有控制地放回哑铃。

cues.en: Lift and lower the shoulder girdle; keep the elbows quiet.
cues.zh: 上提、放下肩带，手肘不乱动。

cues.en: Keep the neck long and the head centred.
cues.zh: 脖子自然延长，头不歪。

mistakes.en: Rolling the shoulders in a circle. Why: it adds movement that is not needed for controlled elevation.
mistakes.zh: 肩膀绕圈。为什么：这增加了受控上提不需要的运动。

mistakes.en: Bending the elbows or bouncing the knees. Why: the arms and legs move the weights instead of the shoulder elevators.
mistakes.zh: 屈肘或弹膝借力。为什么：重量被手臂和腿带动，而不是由提肩肌控制。

text.en: Choose a load or assistance level that lets you control the whole movement, and progress gradually when the same technique feels easy.
text.zh: 选择能控制整个动作的重量或辅助程度；同样的动作变得轻松后，再逐步加难。

text.en: Rest until you can repeat the movement smoothly, and end the effort when control begins to fade.
text.zh: 休息到能重新平稳完成动作；控制开始变差时，就结束这一轮。

cautions.en: The 3D view traces the shoulder and elbow paths with a shortened range; use the two-panel drawing for the full body position and apparatus.
cautions.zh: 三维视图以缩小幅度描出肩、肘的运动；完整体位和器械请看两格示意图。

cautions.en: Stop if the movement causes neck pain, headache or symptoms spreading into the arm.
cautions.zh: 出现颈痛、头痛或向手臂放射的不适时停止。

cautions.en: First learn with bodyweight, assistance or a light load under a qualified coach; anyone under 18 should practise under adult supervision.
cautions.zh: 第一次做先用自重、辅助或轻重量，在合格教练指导下学动作；未满 18 岁在成人监督下练习。

cautions.en: This card is general information, not medical advice. For pain or an injury, see a doctor or physiotherapist.
cautions.zh: 本卡片是一般性知识，不是医疗建议；有疼痛或受伤，请咨询医生或物理治疗师。

setup.en: Use a stable incline bench with a low slope. Lie chest down, feet on the floor. Begin without weights; lift only through a small, comfortable range.
setup.zh: 用稳固、低倾角的上斜凳，胸朝下、双脚踩地。先不加重量，只在舒服的小幅度里举臂。

steps.en: Rest the chest against the pad and keep the head in line with the spine. Let the arms hang towards the floor with elbows almost straight.
steps.zh: 胸部贴住靠垫，头与脊柱保持一线；手臂朝地面垂下，手肘接近伸直。

steps.en: Turn the thumbs forward and upward, and aim the arms into a broad Y shape rather than straight out sideways. Keep the abdomen gently braced.
steps.zh: 拇指朝前上方，把手臂对准较宽的 Y 字方向，不是平伸向两侧；腹部轻轻收紧。

steps.en: Breathe out and raise the arms along that Y line. Let the shoulder blades turn upward with the arms; keep the chest on the pad.
steps.zh: 呼气，沿 Y 字方向举臂；肩胛骨跟随手臂向上回旋，胸部不离开靠垫。

steps.en: Stop near the line of the torso, or sooner if you need to arch the back. Pause without forcing a shoulder-blade squeeze.
steps.zh: 接近躯干延长线就停；若需要弓腰才能继续，就更早停。稍停，不强行夹肩胛骨。

steps.en: Breathe in and lower slowly to the hanging position. Sit or step off the bench carefully after finishing.
steps.zh: 吸气，慢慢回到垂臂位置；结束后小心坐起或离开凳子。

cues.en: Reach along the Y line while keeping the chest on the pad.
cues.zh: 沿 Y 字线伸长手臂，胸部贴垫。

cues.en: Let the blades turn upward; keep the neck relaxed.
cues.zh: 肩胛骨向上回旋，颈部放松。

mistakes.en: Lifting the chest and arching the back to raise the hands. Why: trunk extension adds height without the intended shoulder movement.
mistakes.zh: 抬胸、弓腰把手举高。为什么：躯干后伸增加了高度，肩部却没有完成预期运动。

mistakes.en: Forcing the shoulders down throughout the raise. Why: it restricts the scapular upward rotation needed as the arms rise.
mistakes.zh: 整个上举过程都把肩膀死压下去。为什么：这限制了抬臂需要的肩胛骨上回旋。

text.en: Learn the arm path without added weight and keep the chest supported before making the movement harder.
text.zh: 先不加重量学会举臂路线，胸部能稳定贴垫后再加难。

text.en: Use a range you can control, and stop when the lift requires the back or neck to compensate.
text.zh: 用能控制的幅度；需要腰背或颈部代偿时，就停止这一轮。

cautions.en: The 3D view traces the shoulder and elbow paths with a shortened range; use the two-panel drawing for the full body position and apparatus.
cautions.zh: 三维视图以缩小幅度描出肩、肘的运动；完整体位和器械请看两格示意图。

cautions.en: Use a shorter range if overhead arm movement is uncomfortable; do not add weights just to feel a stronger burn.
cautions.zh: 举臂不舒服时减小幅度；不要只为追求更强酸胀就加重量。

cautions.en: First learn with bodyweight, assistance or a light load under a qualified coach; anyone under 18 should practise under adult supervision.
cautions.zh: 第一次做先用自重、辅助或轻重量，在合格教练指导下学动作；未满 18 岁在成人监督下练习。

cautions.en: This card is general information, not medical advice. For pain or an injury, see a doctor or physiotherapist.
cautions.zh: 本卡片是一般性知识，不是医疗建议；有疼痛或受伤，请咨询医生或物理治疗师。

setup.en: Use a barbell with collars on a level floor. For learning, use light technique plates or sturdy blocks to place the bar at a reachable height; have a qualified coach teach the hip hinge first. Hip extensors, including gluteus maximus and the hamstrings, supply movement; spinal erectors mainly brace. The muscle chips show the muscles included in this back view. Knee extensors also help lift a conventional deadlift.
setup.zh: 在平整地面上用装好卡扣的杠铃。学习时用轻的技术杠片或稳固垫块，把杠放到容易够到的高度；先请合格教练指导髋折叠。 臀大肌和腘绳肌等伸髋肌产生运动，竖脊肌主要稳定；肌肉标签只列出背部视图所收录的肌肉。 常规硬拉还需要伸膝肌群参与。

steps.en: Stand with feet about hip width and the bar over the middle of the feet. Hinge at the hips, then bend the knees enough to reach an overhand grip just outside the legs.
steps.zh: 双脚约与髋同宽，杠在脚的中部上方。先屈髋向后坐，再屈膝到能正握杠铃，握距略宽于双腿。

steps.en: Bring the shins close to the bar and keep the arms long. Find a comfortable neutral spinal shape, with the head following the trunk and the abdomen braced.
steps.zh: 小腿靠近杠，手臂伸长。找到舒服的脊柱中立形态，头跟随躯干，腹部收紧。

steps.en: Take the slack out of the bar gently before lifting. Keep it close to the legs; the lats help hold its position while the spinal erectors resist bending.
steps.zh: 起拉前轻轻收紧身体与杠之间的松弛。杠靠近双腿；背阔肌帮助稳住杠的位置，竖脊肌抵抗脊柱前屈。

steps.en: Push through the floor and extend the knees and hips together, letting the bar rise close to the shins and thighs. Keep the back shape steady rather than rounding and straightening it.
steps.zh: 向地面施力，髋和膝一起伸展，杠沿小腿、大腿附近上升。脊柱形态保持稳定，不反复弓起再挺直。

steps.en: Finish standing tall with the hips and knees extended, arms long and shoulders relaxed. Do not lean backwards or shrug to add height.
steps.zh: 站直，髋和膝伸展，手臂伸长，肩膀自然放稳；不后仰、不耸肩增加高度。

steps.en: Send the hips back and lower the bar close to the thighs, bending the knees further once the bar passes them. Rest it on the floor, breathe and reset before lifting again.
steps.zh: 髋向后移，让杠贴近大腿下降；杠经过膝盖后再进一步屈膝。杠落地，呼吸、重新站稳后再起拉。

cues.en: Keep the bar close and move at the hips and knees.
cues.zh: 杠靠近身体，髋和膝产生运动。

cues.en: Hold the spinal shape while the trunk changes its angle.
cues.zh: 躯干倾角变化时，脊柱形态保持稳定。

cues.en: Stand tall at the top; do not lean back.
cues.zh: 顶端站直即可，不后仰。

mistakes.en: Jerking the bar from the floor. Why: a sudden pull removes the controlled setup and makes it harder to keep the bar close.
mistakes.zh: 猛地把杠从地面拽起。为什么：突然发力破坏了稳定的准备位置，杠也更难靠近身体。

mistakes.en: Rounding and then extending the spine to finish. Why: the motion shifts from hip and knee extension to spinal movement under load.
mistakes.zh: 先弓背、再挺背完成起拉。为什么：运动从髋、膝伸展转移成负重下的脊柱运动。

text.en: Choose a load or assistance level that lets you control the whole movement, and progress gradually when the same technique feels easy.
text.zh: 选择能控制整个动作的重量或辅助程度；同样的动作变得轻松后，再逐步加难。

text.en: Rest until you can repeat the movement smoothly, and end the effort when control begins to fade.
text.zh: 休息到能重新平稳完成动作；控制开始变差时，就结束这一轮。

cautions.en: The hip hinge is shown in the two-panel drawing; this model shows the back muscles holding the spine steady.
cautions.zh: 髋折叠见两格示意图；本模型用于观察背肌稳住脊柱的工作。

cautions.en: If you cannot reach the floor while controlling the spinal position, raise the bar on suitable blocks and learn with lighter loading.
cautions.zh: 控制好脊柱时够不到地面，就用合适的垫块抬高杠，从更轻的负重开始学。

cautions.en: Stop for sharp back pain, tingling, unusual weakness or pain spreading into a leg.
cautions.zh: 下背刺痛、麻感、异常无力或疼痛向腿部放射时停止。

cautions.en: First learn with bodyweight, assistance or a light load under a qualified coach; anyone under 18 should practise under adult supervision.
cautions.zh: 第一次做先用自重、辅助或轻重量，在合格教练指导下学动作；未满 18 岁在成人监督下练习。

cautions.en: This card is general information, not medical advice. For pain or an injury, see a doctor or physiotherapist.
cautions.zh: 本卡片是一般性知识，不是医疗建议；有疼痛或受伤，请咨询医生或物理治疗师。

setup.en: Use a stable back-extension station with a sloping support around 45°. Set the upper edge of the pad just below the hip crease so the hips can hinge; secure the ankles as designed. Hip extensors, including gluteus maximus and the hamstrings, supply movement; spinal erectors mainly brace. The muscle chips show the muscles included in this back view.
setup.zh: 用稳固的背伸展凳，支撑面约倾斜 45°。垫子上缘调到髋折痕稍下方，让髋能折叠；按器械设计固定脚踝。 臀大肌和腘绳肌等伸髋肌产生运动，竖脊肌主要稳定；肌肉标签只列出背部视图所收录的肌肉。

steps.en: Step into the support carefully, feet secure and knees softly extended. Cross the hands over the chest or keep them close to the body.
steps.zh: 小心进入支撑位置，脚固定好，膝接近伸直但不硬顶；双手交叉放胸前或靠近身体。

steps.en: Start with the head, trunk and legs in a comfortable line along the sloping support. Gently brace the abdomen and keep the back’s natural shape.
steps.zh: 从头、躯干与双腿沿斜面成自然直线的位置开始；腹部轻轻收紧，脊柱保持自然形态。

steps.en: Breathe in and send the hips back over the pad, folding at the hip crease until the torso slopes down in a range you can control. Keep the spine steady.
steps.zh: 吸气，在垫子上屈髋，沿髋折痕向前折叠，躯干下降到能控制的幅度；脊柱保持稳定。

steps.en: Breathe out and press the hips into the support as you extend them, raising the torso back into line with the legs. The buttocks and thighs move you while the back columns brace.
steps.zh: 呼气，髋部贴着支撑伸展，让躯干回到与腿成一线的位置。臀部和大腿推动运动，背部肌柱负责稳定。

steps.en: Stop at that line without lifting the chest further or throwing the head back. Lower smoothly for the next movement, then use the hand supports to step out.
steps.zh: 回到一线就停，不继续挺胸、不甩头后仰；下一次平稳下放，结束后借扶手小心离开。

cues.en: Fold at the hips rather than curling the spine.
cues.zh: 在髋部折叠，不卷曲脊柱。

cues.en: Rise only to the line of the legs.
cues.zh: 只起到与双腿成一线。

mistakes.en: Throwing the torso upward beyond the leg line. Why: it adds spinal extension instead of the intended hip movement.
mistakes.zh: 猛甩躯干，起到超过双腿延长线。为什么：这增加的是脊柱后伸，不是预期的伸髋。

mistakes.en: Setting the pad over the abdomen. Why: it blocks the hip crease and encourages movement to come from the spine.
mistakes.zh: 垫子上缘压在腹部。为什么：它挡住髋折痕，容易让动作改由脊柱完成。

text.en: Choose a load or assistance level that lets you control the whole movement, and progress gradually when the same technique feels easy.
text.zh: 选择能控制整个动作的重量或辅助程度；同样的动作变得轻松后，再逐步加难。

text.en: Rest until you can repeat the movement smoothly, and end the effort when control begins to fade.
text.zh: 休息到能重新平稳完成动作；控制开始变差时，就结束这一轮。

cautions.en: The hip hinge is shown in the two-panel drawing; this model shows the back muscles holding the spine steady.
cautions.zh: 髋折叠见两格示意图；本模型用于观察背肌稳住脊柱的工作。

cautions.en: Learn without added load and check that the station and ankle supports suit your body size.
cautions.zh: 先不加负重，确认凳子和脚踝固定装置适合你的体型。

cautions.en: Stop if the pad causes abdominal discomfort or the movement brings sharp back pain.
cautions.zh: 垫子压得腹部不适，或动作引起下背刺痛时停止。

cautions.en: First learn with bodyweight, assistance or a light load under a qualified coach; anyone under 18 should practise under adult supervision.
cautions.zh: 第一次做先用自重、辅助或轻重量，在合格教练指导下学动作；未满 18 岁在成人监督下练习。

cautions.en: This card is general information, not medical advice. For pain or an injury, see a doctor or physiotherapist.
cautions.zh: 本卡片是一般性知识，不是医疗建议；有疼痛或受伤，请咨询医生或物理治疗师。

setup.en: Lie on the right side on a firm mat and support the head comfortably. Use a very light dumbbell in the left hand; the drawing shows the left arm working, then reverse the sides.
setup.zh: 在结实垫面上向右侧卧，头部垫到舒服高度；左手用很轻的哑铃。图中练左臂，随后换边。

steps.en: Stack the shoulders and hips rather than rolling backwards. Bend the knees slightly for balance and let the right arm rest comfortably.
steps.zh: 两肩、两髋上下叠放，不向后滚；膝盖略屈帮助稳定，右臂自然放好。

steps.en: Keep the left upper arm beside the ribs, with a small towel under it if comfortable. Bend the elbow to a right angle and rest the forearm across the front of the abdomen.
steps.zh: 左上臂靠近肋骨，舒服时可在腋下垫小毛巾；肘屈成直角，前臂横放在腹部前方。

steps.en: Breathe out and rotate the left upper arm outward, lifting the dumbbell in an arc towards the ceiling. The elbow stays beside the body and the wrist stays straight.
steps.zh: 呼气，左上臂向外旋，哑铃沿弧线朝天花板方向抬起；手肘留在身体旁，手腕平直。

steps.en: Stop before the elbow lifts away or the torso rolls back. Use a comfortable range rather than trying to reach the farthest possible rotation.
steps.zh: 手肘要离开身体、或躯干要向后滚之前就停；用舒服的幅度，不追求最大外旋。

steps.en: Breathe in and lower slowly along the same arc towards the abdomen. Set the dumbbell down under control before rolling over to change sides.
steps.zh: 吸气，沿同一条弧线慢慢放回腹部前方；先有控制地放好哑铃，再翻身换边。

cues.en: Turn the upper arm while the elbow stays in place.
cues.zh: 上臂旋转，手肘位置不变。

cues.en: Keep the shoulders stacked and the wrist straight.
cues.zh: 两肩上下叠放，手腕平直。

mistakes.en: Rolling the chest towards the ceiling. Why: the whole body carries the dumbbell instead of the shoulder rotating it.
mistakes.zh: 胸口转向天花板。为什么：整个身体把哑铃带起来，代替了肩关节外旋。

mistakes.en: Lifting the elbow away from the side. Why: the action becomes arm elevation and changes which muscles move the load.
mistakes.zh: 手肘抬离身体。为什么：动作变成举臂，带动重量的肌肉也发生变化。

text.en: Choose a load or assistance level that lets you control the whole movement, and progress gradually when the same technique feels easy.
text.zh: 选择能控制整个动作的重量或辅助程度；同样的动作变得轻松后，再逐步加难。

text.en: Rest until you can repeat the movement smoothly, and end the effort when control begins to fade.
text.zh: 休息到能重新平稳完成动作；控制开始变差时，就结束这一轮。

cautions.en: The 3D view traces the shoulder and elbow paths with a shortened range; use the two-panel drawing for the full body position and apparatus.
cautions.zh: 三维视图以缩小幅度描出肩、肘的运动；完整体位和器械请看两格示意图。

cautions.en: Use a smaller range or no weight if the shoulder pinches; this card is not a rehabilitation prescription.
cautions.zh: 肩部有夹痛时减小幅度或不加重量；本卡不是康复处方。

cautions.en: First learn with bodyweight, assistance or a light load under a qualified coach; anyone under 18 should practise under adult supervision.
cautions.zh: 第一次做先用自重、辅助或轻重量，在合格教练指导下学动作；未满 18 岁在成人监督下练习。

cautions.en: This card is general information, not medical advice. For pain or an injury, see a doctor or physiotherapist.
cautions.zh: 本卡片是一般性知识，不是医疗建议；有疼痛或受伤，请咨询医生或物理治疗师。

text.en: Reinold et al. (2004) used intramuscular EMG in 10 healthy participants performing shoulder exercises. Side-lying external rotation produced the highest infraspinatus and teres-minor activity among the tested exercises. This small study did not measure long-term strength or growth.
text.zh: Reinold 等（2004）用肌内电极记录了 10 名健康受试者做肩部动作时的肌电。在受测动作中，侧卧外旋的冈下肌和小圆肌活动最高。这项小研究没有测量长期力量或肌肉增长。
